title: Readiness Inspector: ready for what?
audience: Maintainers who need a goal-specific readiness answer without hiding missing, stale, blocked, or failed checks behind one score.
promise: Declare a goal, inspect each owner-bound predicate, preserve its evidence and state, and follow the next action.
story: A versioned release-candidate profile declares individual checks and binds them to one target revision.
Current-dev inspect and run commands record passing tests and standards checks with owner, evidence, target, and next action.
A mutating check is blocked because it would change state without separate authority, while an unknown check remains unsupported.
Failed-check behavior is covered by the source tests, while upstream projection and stale matrices stay visible as open gates.
verified_locally: Current-dev CLI inspect and run commands record two checks against target 2efa5ed6.
Passed receipts, unknown-check unsupported, and mutating-check blocked outcomes remain individual.
Source tests cover failed-check receipts without collapsing the state into a score.
Source tests, lint, and package checks pass; the 1600×900 SVG/PNG preview is rendered and visually inspected.
open_gates: Project Quality Setup and Evidence Replay receipts as owner-bound checks.
Expand stale, contradictory, and not-applicable state coverage.
Prove native follow-up navigation for failed checks.
Verify a hosted no-auth case and record external destination readbacks.
claim_boundary: This is a current-dev candidate packet for explainable goal-specific checks and a reviewed binary preview; it does not claim complete upstream projection, full stale/contradictory/not-applicable coverage, native follow-up navigation, hosting, or publication.
